readPath.contract: A read must not move the index. Phase A: one handler call created a 98,912-byte WAL and changed db bytes; the public MCP door did the same (sha e5a360e7…→60ff3fc7…). Phase B: the settled index's sha256 is identical before and after a public-door read (e6580252…→e6580252…, dbBytesChanged false), the WAL file is created empty as SQLite's shared-memory coordination (campaign protocol: content + non-empty WAL unchanged, file existence not the claim), and an unindexed project is a loud 'no index found' error that creates nothing.
